title: Getting Started Tour
description: Learn how to get started with MyAssist in this quick introductory tour, highly recommended for new users

steps.title: Welcome to MyAssist
steps.description:
Welcome to the new and improved MyAssist! We've rebuilt from the ground up to give you access to more powerful AI tools.

In this guided tour, we'll take you through the chat interface and side panel, so you are comfortable navigating through the platform.

steps.title: New Chat
steps.description: Click here any time to start a brand new conversation. Your current chat is saved automatically, so nothing is lost.

steps.title: Model
steps.description:
Pick which model or agent answers your messages. Different options are better at different tasks — some are faster, some handle longer documents, and some are better at reasoning. A higher cost factor generally means a model is better suited to complex tasks.

If you require your data to stay onshore in Australia, choose a model provider with "AU" in the title.

steps.title: Message Box
steps.description: Type your message here. Press Enter to send, or Shift+Enter for a new line within the same message.

steps.title: Attach Files
steps.description: Click to attach a file for the model to use.

steps.title: Run Code
steps.description:
Run Code is automatically enabled by default.

This gives MyAssist a secure working area to analyse data, work through calculations, transform files, and produce charts or tables for you behind the scenes.

steps.title: Skills
steps.description:
Skills are automatically enabled by default.

Skills are specialised instruction files that provide the AI with expertise for specific tasks and actions. If a skill is enabled, MyAssist will automatically use it when it can help with your request or the action you want to complete.

For example, if you ask the AI to summarise a meeting, you may see the meeting-summariser skill appear while your response or action is being generated.

steps.title: Artifacts
steps.description:
Artifacts are automatically enabled by default.

This produces rich outputs like formatted documents, diagrams, and interactive previews in a separate panel alongside your chat — ideal for iterating on deliverables such as reports, data visualisations, or presentation content.

steps.title: Connectors
steps.description: Use connectors to give MyAssist access to approved data sources and systems, so it can answer questions with information beyond the current chat.

steps.title: Send
steps.description: Click here or hit Enter to send your message. This button lights up once you have typed something.

steps.title: Sidebar Toggle
steps.description: Collapses or expands the sidebar to give your conversation more room, or to bring back quick access to your chats, agents, and settings.

steps.title: Conversations
steps.description: The default panel — your chat history, search, and projects all live here.

steps.title: Projects
steps.description: Group related conversations into a project folder to keep long-running work organised and easy to find later.

steps.title: Agent Builder
steps.description: Agents are a collection of skills, connectors, files, and instructions grouped together for a specific job. Build and configure your own here.

steps.title: Agent Marketplace
steps.description: Browse pre-built agents for common tasks. Each agent combines instructions, skills, connectors, files, and guidance so you can get started faster.

steps.title: Switch Back to a Model
steps.description: If you are using an agent and want to return to a general model, open this selector and choose a standard model instead.

steps.title: Skill Library
steps.description: This is where you can create, edit and share skills. Skills are specialised instruction files that provide the AI with expertise for specific tasks and actions.

steps.title: Prompt Library
steps.description: This is where you can create, edit and share prompts. Save prompt templates you use often, then trigger them in chat by typing / to bring up the prompt search, instead of retyping them.

steps.title: Memories
steps.description: Review and manage what the assistant remembers about you across conversations.

steps.title: Files
steps.description: See every file you have uploaded across all your conversations in one place.

steps.title: Parameters
steps.description: Adjust advanced response settings for the current conversation.

steps.title: Connectors
steps.description: This is where you see the list of connectors available to you.

steps.title: MyAssist Academy
steps.description: You're here right now! Come back any time to revisit this tour or check for new learning content.

steps.title: Balance
steps.description:
This gauge shows how much of your daily MyAssist usage balance you have left. Hover over it for more details.

To conserve your balance, choose a lower-cost model — you can compare model costs in the model selector.

steps.title: Account Menu
steps.description: Access your profile, settings, theme, and sign-out option from here.
